attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Unique invoice reference number or identifier

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Invoice issuance date in DD.MM.YYYY format (e.g. 21.09.2026)

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Payment due date in DD.MM.YYYY format (e.g. 15.10.2026)

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the vendor or supplier issuing the invoice

attributes.name: vendor_vat_id
attributes.description: VAT or tax identification number of the vendor

attributes.name: customer_name
attributes.description: Name of the customer or client being billed

attributes.name: customer_vat_id
attributes.description: VAT or tax identification number of the customer

attributes.name: line_items
attributes.description: JSON array string or formatted list of line items including description, quantity, unit price, and item total

attributes.name: subtotal
attributes.description: Net subtotal amount before VAT or taxes

attributes.name: vat_rate
attributes.description: VAT or tax percentage rate (e.g. 20 for 20%)

attributes.name: vat_amount
attributes.description: Total calculated or stated VAT tax amount

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final grand total invoice amount including all taxes

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: Bank account IBAN number for payment

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms or conditions (e.g. Net 30, Due on receipt)

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You are a strict, precision-oriented enterprise invoice data extraction specialist. Your task is to extract structured invoice data from the provided text according to the exact schema. Follow these rules strictly:
1. Grounding: Extract values ONLY if they are explicitly stated in the source text. NEVER guess, assume, or fabricate any missing information.
2. Missing Fields: If any field is not found or not mentioned in the text, leave it empty or null.
3. Dates: Normalize all dates into DD.MM.YYYY format (day.month.year, e.g. 21.09.2026).
4. Numbers: Extract monetary values as clean numbers (float/integer) without currency symbols or commas.
5. Line Items: Return line items as a clean JSON-formatted array string containing description, quantity, unit price, and total.
6. Currency: Use standard 3-letter ISO codes (EUR, USD, GBP, etc.).
